newsitem.title: UK: Jet barge premiums gain on deals, but not cargoes.
newsitem.headline: Jet barge premiums gain on deals, but not cargoes.

text.p: European jet fuel was steady to firmer on Friday, bolstered by narrowly stronger IPE gas oil futures and a slight, but temporary gain on barge premiums.
April IPE gas oil last traded at $162.25, a gain of 25 cents against Thursday.

Barge premiums were bolstered by a trade heard today at May IPE +$17.50 fob ARA putting April at +$19. Traders said the spike up was originally on the back of upwards of 34,000 tonnes trading out of the barge market over the last couple of days.
But, traders the gain was likely to be short-lived with prices expected to drift back fo April IPE +$17-18 fob next week.
"This blip has not translated through into the cargo market and it probably will not last," said one trader.
"Options for jet as a blender are going, so there will be more available and there is no arb opportunity," said one dealer.
Cargo permiums were pegged steady around April IPE +$22 cif NWE.
